role: Independent source reviewer; neither provider implementation nor provider test author. No original production or test edits.
sourceConclusions: Default bean fails with CONFIGURATION before network: missing key, unverified total billed output/reasoning cap, or unsupported requested output limit. No production opt-in flag was added.

Single physical exchange: connection retry and all redirects disabled; network interceptor rejects non-200 before OkHttp HTTP follow-up, including 503 Retry-After: 0. Credentials are an HTTP header and never a query parameter.

One monotonic deadline covers serialization, call, header/body streaming and parse. Total budget is at most 15 seconds. Actual request and streamed response are bounded to 16 KiB; response EOF/stall remains under call deadline.

Strict JSON parser rejects duplicates/trailing data, absent/unknown/invalid payload fields and invalid envelope/finishReason. NEEDS_CHOICE requires exact A/B, distinct complete alternatives, exact original excerpt and bounded Unicode lengths. CLEAR and NEEDS_EDIT cannot silently carry question fields.

Output usage validates each and combined known candidate/thinking tokens <=2048. Missing thinking/candidate usage remains unknown rather than zero. Provider/model metadata delta only stamps trusted configuration after successful parse.

Prompt instructs material ambiguity only, deliberate broad ranges/contextually clear input => CLEAR, no regex semantic decisions or automatic text conversion, user confirmation for alternatives, no personal AREA/group/cache reuse. These instructions are not evidence of actual model semantic accuracy.
Final boundedText NUL guard inspected and independent escaped-NUL prompt/label cases each fail with INVALID_RESPONSE; final archived provider18 tests contain zero failures/errors/skips.
